cause_quote: The new Turn on button used `disabled={current().enabling}`, so keyboard focus fell to the document body when activation began.
user_saw: The Skill Workshop off panel was misaligned, showed raw Gateway errors, and lost keyboard focus during activation, with “Turning on…” stuck indefinitely if the update never arrived.
summary: The fix stacks the off panel, summarizes Gateway failures with expandable details, preserves and hands off keyboard focus, and rechecks plugin status if the Workshop does not load.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and its parent and confirmed that #192766 added the off panel and its in-page activation flow. The new panel inherited an existing CSS rule that overrode its grid, and the new activation handler left the button busy after success until a Gateway broadcast arrived, with no fallback if the broadcast was missed.
